name: Willow
source:
Who is Willow? She's a judgy Vegan. An Atheist who says she wears a cross "ironically". A gifted student who barely bothers to show up to class. A sad soul with a tragic past.

A brush with death awakens Willow's powers. But don't expect them to improve her attitude.
[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2052836802/wicked-willow/description[/url]the Kickstarter campaign].
